title: C2S-Scale 27B Discovers & Wet-Lab Validates a Novel Cancer Immunotherapy Pathway
whyItMatters: Google DeepMind and Yale’s 27B-parameter single-cell foundation model predicted a context-dependent cancer immunotherapy drug combo (silmitasertib + low-dose interferon) that boosted antigen presentation ~50% in wet-lab tests.
summary: Developed by Google DeepMind and Yale University and unveiled in October 2025 (bioRxiv 2025.04.14.648850v2), Cell2Sentence-Scale (C2S-Scale 27B) translates single-cell RNA-seq profiles into biological 'cell sentences' processed by a 27-billion-parameter Gemma foundation model. Running a virtual screen of >4,000 drugs across immune-context-positive and immune-context-neutral tumor microenvironments, C2S-Scale 27B generated an unexpected, context-conditioned hypothesis: that the CK2 kinase inhibitor silmitasertib (CX-4945) dramatically amplifies MHC-I antigen presentation specifically in the presence of low-dose interferon. Laboratory experiments in human neuroendocrine cell models confirmed an ~50% boost in antigen presentation—a potential mechanism for turning immunologically 'cold' tumors 'hot'.
technicalHighlights: Scaled single-cell transcriptomic modeling to 27 billion parameters on Gemma, uncovering emergent context-dependent perturbation reasoning absent in smaller models.
Screened >4,000 compounds across dual immune contexts to predict a previously unestablished synergy between silmitasertib (CX-4945) and low-dose interferon.
Experimentally confirmed an ~50% increase in antigen presentation in human neuroendocrine cell models, validating a genuine AI-originated biomedical hypothesis.
caveats: Validated in human in vitro cell models and posted on bioRxiv rather than a peer-reviewed clinical journal; in vivo animal oncology studies and human clinical trials are required to test therapeutic efficacy.

scoreRationale.foundational: Demonstrated that scaling single-cell foundation models unlocks emergent, context-conditioned biological hypothesis generation.
scoreRationale.ripple: Provides an open 27B single-cell reasoning model and validates a new blueprint for AI-originated combination oncology discoveries.
scoreRationale.verification: Experimentally confirmed in Yale wet-lab human cell models, though still a bioRxiv preprint awaiting peer review and in vivo clinical testing.
scoreRationale.velocity: Virtually screened >4,000 compounds across nuanced immune-context perturbations to pinpoint a non-obvious drug synergy.
